prose: Reuters reports that OpenAI says teenagers use ChatGPT for under 15 minutes a day, as concern about risks to young users grows. The article is not accessible to this pipeline (Reuters returned an authorization error), so the summary relies on the headline.
Basis: headline. How OpenAI measured this, which age groups it covers and what safety measures accompany the figure are not available here.

Reported amid growing worries over risks to teens
